## Required

11 mandatory fields identify the form, reporting authority, contacts, reporting year and submission.

## Available

The user supplies shared metadata for the per-trip workbooks. The chosen model fixes the form ID and revision.

META provides the dataset entry point in ROS. Metadata is needed when creating a new dataset.

## To decide

Detailed review is deferred. Confirm reporting year/entity, contact matching, and finalisation/submission dates.

Do not substitute the export execution date for those dates without agreement.
